judged_text: The consolidated check raises 'invalid referer host' for every denial, including the case where no embeddable hosts are configured at all, replacing the deleted 'embeddable hosts not set' message and misdescribing the actual failure state. An admin setting up embedding for the first time (empty hosts table) gets 'invalid referer host' on every embed request and debugs their referer/URL instead of discovering they must add a host in the admin UI.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, the explicit `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.blank?` check and its distinct `'embeddable hosts not set'` error were removed and replaced with a single `raise ... 'invalid referer host' unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). When the `embeddable_hosts` table is empty, `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` returns false, so the error message will indeed always be `'invalid referer host'`, losing the more specific diagnostic for the “no hosts configured” state. This is grounded in the diff, but it’s primarily a UX/diagnostics regression rather than a correctness/security failure.
